rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy
rules.quote: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.summary: It is prohibited to sell or use algorithmic devices that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units or manage occupancy levels.
rules.effective_date_evidence: adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024
rules.penalty: allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law
